source.name: Tab must leave a datepicker input for the next field
source.scope: Open upstream bug (https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20datepicker) at 2bb544eb426e9b1e019c2a98798e0002b8a41d35, unfixed when pinned. Routing Super, then Ultra.

journey.title: Tab out of the departure date to the passengers field
journey.goal: Tab moves focus from the date field to the next field, as in any form

functionalJourney.title: Change the passengers with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Editing another field and saving submits the saved departure date

guards.title: Escape still closes the calendar
guards.goal: With the calendar open, Escape closes it and Tab then reaches the passengers field

plan.root_cause: The datepicker popup (vanilla-calendar-pro) traps the Tab key, preventing default focus movement to the next focusable element when the popup is open.
plan.repair_strategy: Change the `inputMode` option passed to vanilla-calendar-pro from `!this._isInline` to `false` for non-inline datepickers. This disables keyboard trapping behavior, allowing the Tab key to move focus out of the datepicker while preserving other keyboard navigation.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Tab when the datepicker is open will close the datepicker (via focusout) and move focus to the next focusable element (#passengers field), matching standard form behavior.
functional_risks: Altered inputMode may affect other keyboard navigation in the datepicker (e.g., arrow keys, Enter), though non-inline datepickers now match inline mode's inputMode setting.
Potential loss of datepicker-specific Tab trapping that might be relied upon for complex date range selection (though current selectionMode is 'single').
Change affects all non-inline datepicker instances; verify no regressions in date selection via keyboard.
verification_requirements: Tab key moves focus from #departure to #passengers when datepicker is open.
Datepicker closes when Tab is pressed (no open popup in background).
Arrow keys, Enter, and Escape keys function correctly in datepicker for date selection.
Mouse interactions with datepicker remain unaffected.
Inline datepickers (if any) continue to work as expected.
